Reptile Transport Rules

This section sets the handling standards for reptile requests at the Companion Animal Travel Desk so staff record the correct charge, keep the ledger current, and move passengers through boarding without delay.

Requests for reptile travel are handled as service changes and must be entered in the desk ledger as soon as they are accepted. The accepting agent confirms the traveler details, checks the route, and applies the fee exactly as published. <<FACT F060>> Staff must not quote an unverified amount, must not promise acceptance before the record is complete, and must not alter the entry after boarding clearance without supervisor review.

The desk treats reptile movement as a controlled service item. The traveler receives the fee notice before any acceptance is final, and the welcome team is informed when the record is closed so boarding prep can proceed in order. If a traveler such as Liam Ali or Grace Kim presents a reptile for travel, the agent follows the same sequence without favor or exception. Any crate, carrier, or handling note tied to the request is to be logged in plain language and kept consistent with the passenger file.

If the desk must refuse the request because the record is incomplete, the agent states the reason in clear terms and refers the traveler back to the sales or service channel for correction. When acceptance is confirmed, the agent marks the ledger immediately and keeps the note brief, factual, and legible. Do not add comments that are not needed for operations, and do not let informal advice replace the recorded rule. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is responsible for dependable companion travel, and that standard applies to every reptile entry that reaches the counter.

Any discrepancy in fee handling, ledger entry, or boarding status is escalated at once to the senior coordinator, who reviews the file and directs the next step. If the traveler is already at the gate, the welcome team is notified so the passenger and animal can be managed in sequence with the rest of the boarding flow. Handle each request with calm pace, exact records, and no unnecessary delay.
